name: generate_pink_noise_murmur
mechanism: Generates the base murmur signal using pink noise instead of white noise by scaling the frequency domain amplitudes by 1/sqrt(f) to better model the natural spectral roll-off.

name: model_physiological_envelope_diversity
mechanism: Introduces distinct amplitude envelope shapes, such as plateau and decrescendo, to simulate different physiological subtypes of a condition.

name: enhance_broadband_valve_click
mechanism: Increases the decay rate and amplitude ratio of the broadband transient click in heart sounds to make them more prominent and realistic in the spectrogram.
code_snippet: env_click = np.exp(-250 * t); sound = thump + 0.4 * click
